en.t: dory-turbo on CUDA and over Vulkan, one card
en.sub: NVIDIA RTX 3090 (24 GB), cortiq bench --core: 60 tokens after a prompt of that length. Release build, the same file.
en.res: 64 000 tokens: first token in 33.0 s instead of 162.6, then 214.1 tok/s instead of 91.6
